name: PMO Resumen Ejecutivo
PMO Situación Económica
PMO Panorama Operativo
PMO Customers
style: :host{display:block;width:100%}.pmo-c{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-color);padding-top:2px}.pmo-c .empty{padding:12px;border:1px dashed var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:12px}.pmo-c .pill{display:inline-block;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#fff}.pmo-c .pill.ok{background:var(--green-500)}.pmo-c .pill.warn{background:var(--orange-500)}.pmo-c .pill.bad{background:var(--red-500)}.pmo-c .pill.gray{background:var(--gray-500)}.pmo-c .wrap{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px}.pmo-c table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:520px}.pmo-c th,.pmo-c td{padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color);text-align:left;font-size:12px}.pmo-c thead th{background:var(--subtle-fg,var(--gray-100));color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap}.pmo-c td.num{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

name: PMO Attention
PMO Governance
